title: Selling with no internet
summary: When the internet drops, keep selling: sales print and wait on the device, and send by themselves when the internet is back.

steps.say: The internet drops: the status turns Offline

steps.caption: No internet: the status in the header says Offline. Keep selling as usual.

steps.say: Keep selling. The invoice still prints.
The sales wait on this device

steps.caption: Two sales made offline: the header shows them waiting to send.

steps.say: Even after a refresh or a restart, SparkPOS opens and the sales are still there

steps.caption: Refreshed with no internet: SparkPOS opens from the device and the 2 sales are still waiting.

steps.say: The internet is back: waiting sales send by themselves

steps.caption: Back online: the waiting sales have been sent and the status says Online.

name: 12-offline
